item.title: Asian Junk Bonds Underperform as Iran War Exposes Oil Dependence
item.description: Asian high-yield dollar bonds are getting disproportionately hit compared with global peers as the escalating Iran conflict underscores the region’s reliance on imported energy, in sharp contrast with the US.

item.title: IMF Says 10% Oil Rise for Year Adds 40 Basis Points to Inflation
item.description: A 10% increase in energy prices that persists for a year would push global inflation up by 40 basis points and slow economic growth by 0.1-0.2%, International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said.

item.title: Stocks Recover as Dollar Slips, Oil Pares Losses: Markets Wrap
item.description: Stocks rebounded on the final trading day of a volatile week, aided by a weaker dollar and US efforts to soften the impact of an oil-price spike tied to the ongoing war in the Middle East. Gold and silver rose.

item.title: Turkey Spends $12 Billion to Defend Lira From War-Fueled Turmoil
item.description: Turkey has spent $12 billion, equal to roughly 15% of its foreign-currency reserves, to keep the lira stable during a week of global market volatility triggered by the war in Iran.

item.title: Oil Powers to 18% Weekly Surge as War Paralyzes Hormuz Traffic
item.description: Oil headed for the biggest weekly surge since 2022 as the war in the Middle East unleashed a wave of disruption across energy markets, with shipping through the Strait of Hormuz at a near-total halt.

item.title: Iran Conflict Sends Farmers Rushing to Secure Critical Fertilizers
item.description: A third of global fertilizer supply passes through the Strait of Hormuz, while gas from the region is crucial to production of nutrients for global agriculture.

item.title: US Grants Temporary Waiver for India to Import Russian Oil
item.description: The US has cleared the way for India to temporarily increase its purchases of Russian oil, reversing months of pressure on the world’s third-largest crude importer as an escalating conflict in the Persian Gulf upends energy flows.

item.title: Poland to Avoid Rate Cuts Until Iran War Ends, Wnorowski Says
item.description: Poland will likely abstain from interest-rate cuts for as long as the armed conflict in Iran lasts, according to policymaker Henryk Wnorowski.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Is at Near-Total Halt, JMIC Says
item.description: Maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has ground to a near-complete halt, with no oil shipments going through in the past 24 hours, as the Middle East war disrupts the vital waterway.

item.title: Trump Team Downplays Treasury Oil Futures Trades as Prices Surge
item.description: The Trump administration is ruling out deploying the Treasury Department to trade oil futures for now, according to a person familiar with the matter, as government officials look tame energy prices that have climbed amid the Iran war.
